regions.merged_text: You must think that there must be something not exactly right with that old Fr. Solanus down at Saint Felix. Indeed there is plenty wrong with him - has always been, at least as long as I can remember. Deo gratias. I wrote Rev. Mother yesterday and gave her every every assurance of my approval of your joining them - in fact congratulating them on your aquisition and enrolling their community in the Seraphic Mass Association in the hopes that you may in one or more ways presage a speeding up of vocations -- Ahl God willing, a speeding up in numbers and holyness before God. God bless you again Miss Haf - as above. It is time for the collecter. So please pardon my abruptness. Remind me again of the Clairs, and about your poor Brother too. God help us.
